ctx.x: Yeah. In Munich, Germany. Augustus Bopp, Munich, Germany, 1859. I think this was an old German calvary horn. Anyway, it's a beautiful-sounding instrument, ancient, but... George Strusell, who has since moved to Sweden, put this instrument together and made it work. He's an amazing technician with brass instruments. Since he's gone, there's another one here, Larry Kimick, who is in Culver City on Sepulveda Boulevard, who is an excellent repair guy.
So that accounts for my five tubas.
